title: Macros for system calls
description:
Shorten repeated code with NASM macros.

```
Hello
World
exit code 0
```

starter.main.asm:
global  _start

%define STDOUT 1

%macro EXIT 1
        mov     eax, 60
        mov     edi, %1
        syscall
%endmacro

        section .data
hello:  db      "Hello", 10

        section .text
_start:
        ; TODO: WRITE hello, 6 and WRITE world, 6
        EXIT    0

hints: `%macro WRITE 2` / `mov eax, 1` / `mov edi, STDOUT` / `lea rsi, [rel %1]` / `mov edx, %2` / `syscall` / `%endmacro` (lesson 7.02).
`%%label` gives each expansion its own name, so two uses of the macro do not define the same label twice.
requirements: `%macro WRITE 2` (address, length) and `%macro EXIT 1` that expand to the system calls.
A `%define` for standard output and `%assign` for a counter of how many messages exist.
A macro with a local label (`%%skip`) used twice without clashing.
stretch: Write `STR name, "text"` that defines both the string and `name_len`.
